body.statement:
Define the restricted class
\[
\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)
=\left\{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(\lambda):
P\text{ satisfies \texttt{ass:event-full-design-mean-stability} and
\texttt{ass:historical-full-design-centering}}\right\}.
\]
There are constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), depending only on fixed class constants, such that along every array with \(N\wedge T\wedge\min_s n_s\to\infty\), uniformly for \(P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\) and \(P\)-almost every \(z_0\in\mathcal Z_+\),
\[
cR_\star
\le\inf_{\widetilde\tau}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)}
\mathbb E_P[(\widetilde\tau-\tau_n(z_0))^2\mid E_0]
\le\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)}
\mathbb E_P[(\widehat\tau-\tau_n(z_0))^2\mid E_0]
\le CR_\star.
\]
The raw feasible estimator in \texttt{def:feasible-estimator} attains the upper bound with nonidentically distributed bounded event outcomes, an unknown heteroskedastic donor law, and estimated full \(\Sigma\).
body.justification: The theorem closes the joint-panel upper-and-lower frontier across arbitrary relative growth rates.
body.gap: Yan, Yao, and Zhou cover repeated-measurement prediction and Akhavan--Gogolashvili--Tsybakov cover an estimated strongly convex minimizer; neither has a causal joint law, a first-order external center, or a realized spacing barrier.
body.consumer: Empirical designers can determine whether adding donor securities, calendar windows, or cohort replications is the only way to reduce causal wealth risk.

obligation.what_is_open: A sharp upper frontier can only be proved after the event full-design mean-stability and historical full-design centering assumptions are adjudicated and incorporated into the panel-law class; the matching converse also awaits the affinity-corrected embedding.
obligation.obstruction: The theorem is false on the frozen class. Conditional cross-unit independence given all historical coordinates permits a shared design-measurable event component that replication does not average away.
obligation.attempted: The event and historical variance decompositions were carried out before applying local-polynomial bounds. They expose surviving covariance of conditional means, and an explicit admissible triangular array makes the feasible estimator's conditional risk stay bounded away from zero while the proposed frontier vanishes.
obligation.partial_result:
The present class does not admit the asserted upper bound.  The explicit legal array in \texttt{prop:shared-design-replication-obstruction} has
\[
R_\star=T^{-2}
\quad\text{but}\quad
\mathbb E[(\widehat\tau-\tau_n(z_0))^2\mid E_0]\longrightarrow\frac{3}{16}.
\]
The variance decomposition identifies the missing term: for event units,
\[
\operatorname{Cov}(B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}},B_{si'}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid E_0)
=\operatorname{Cov}\!\left(
\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid\mathscr X,E_0],
\mathbb E[B_{si'}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid\mathscr X,E_0]
\,middle|\,E_0\right)
\]
for \(i\ne i'\), where \(\mathscr X\) is the full historical design, because conditional independence only removes the conditional covariance.  The proposed full-design mean-stability condition sets this surviving covariance to zero.  The analogous full-design centering condition is needed for replicated historical errors to gain the factor \(n_s^{-1}\).
